newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian PM offers Internet home page.
newsitem.headline: Australian PM offers Internet home page.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard on Monday announced his own home page on the Internet to provide instant access to his speeches and media interviews, as well as information on government policies.

"The new home page covers information of use to Australians and overseas users and includes a range of material of interest to organisations, businesses, individuals, students and children," Howard said in a statement. The site would also include information on his ministers and the constitution.
Howard's Internet address is www.pm.gov.au and came on line over the weekend. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
